characters.name: Kairo
characters.role: A lone cybernetic ninja warrior navigating the neon depths of Neo-Tokyo. Kairo has a sleek armored silhouette built for speed and stealth, with glowing blue circuitry implants running across his body and cybernetic enhancements integrated into his combat gear. His rain-resistant tactical cloak flows dramatically through stormy environments, while his anime-style face conveys determination, isolation, and hidden emotional conflict. He wields a plasma katana that emits unstable neon energy, blending ancient warrior discipline with futuristic technology.
